verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a model lifecycle on its Serverless API, running from release to retirement, so users can plan migrations before a model is retired. The API surface is path-versioned (`/v1/models`). However, the evidence shows no deprecation policy for the API itself: no notice periods, sunset timelines or changelog for API versions. The deprecation coverage is limited to model retirement. Missing for 10: documented API-version (not just model) deprecation policy, explicit notice periods/retirement timelines, API changelog/versioning scheme documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Each model on the Mistral Serverless API moves through a defined lifecycle, from initial release to retirement. Use these stages to choose the right model for production and plan migrations before a model is retired.
Labs models are experimental releases intended to collect feedback before we commit to a production model.
